messages:
maya_finance: FYI nightly NetSuite import skipped 89 usage adjustments for promo_trial plan; looks like we underbilled ~ $3.2k. net-sync-bot shows job 20240315-48 FAILED.

net-sync-bot: Job 20240315-48 failure: NS_ERR_INVALID_ITEM_CODE on line items: promo_adjust_2023 - mapping not found. Logs: /var/logs/netsync/20240315-48.log (snip).

sam_engineering: looking into it. Any recent deploy to the webhook gateway? Header-stripping change could explain missing idempotency.

maya_finance: We noticed Stripe sent several invoice.updated events with retries around 03:12 UTC. In our receiver logs some events have Idempotency-Key empty/absent. Could that cause the import to treat them as orphan adjustments?

eli_reconciler: Yup. If Idempotency-Key is missing our reconciler can't correlate to invoice_item.id so it falls back to adjustment-type mapping. For promo_trial we expect item_code -> NS item mapping, but if invoice_item metadata absent, it tries invoice_item.type='promo_trial_adjustment' which isn't in mapping -> NS_ERR_INVALID_ITEM_CODE -> skip.

sam_engineering: repro steps I used locally:
```
# simulate Stripe retry without idempotency key
curl -i -X POST https://webhooks.internal.redwood/stripe \
  -H 'Stripe-Signature: t=...' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: ' \
  -d @payload_invoice_updated.json
```
Observed: our Kong gateway is dropping headers with empty values before forwarding. If Stripe retries and sends no Idempotency-Key header, downstream never sees invoice_item.unique_id.

ton y_ops: small correction: ops changed the gateway policy on 2024-03-14 to strip empty headers as part of a security cleanup. That would line up with the timing.

jordan_pm: What's the business impact surface? Which customers and how many invoices?

maya_finance: Mostly promo_trial churn/conversion customers. Quick list: ACME Corp, BetaApps, Orbit Labs (internal sheet link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/finance/promo-backfill-20240315). Underbilled ~ $3.2k this run, could be recurring for weekly promos.

sam_engineering: Proposed plan: 1) revert gateway change to preserve Idempotency-Key header (or at least allow empty headers pass-through) 2) run backfill for job 20240315-48 to reprocess skipped adjustments 3) add receiver validation/logging and unit tests to detect missing idempotency early. I'll take 1 & 3. ETA EOD for the gateway rollback + tests.

eli_reconciler: For backfill I'll add a fallback: if Idempotency-Key missing, try to extract invoice_item.id from stripe_event.data.object.lines.data[].id and use that for mapping. That should re-associate most items. I'll run backfill after sam's rollback.

maya_finance: Need to loop in accounting leadership for corrected invoicing approvals if backfill creates charge corrections. I'll prepare an impact estimate and draft email.

sam_engineering: Filed PR #1423 to restore header behavior and added integration test covering blank Idempotency-Key. Deployment scheduled after quick rollback approval. net-sync-bot: queued backfill job 20240315-48-backfill-1.

net-sync-bot: backfill job 20240315-48-backfill-1 started. Reprocessing 89 adjustments...

net-sync-bot: backfill job 20240315-48-backfill-1 completed: reprocessed 89 adjustments; 77 succeeded, 12 still failed due to unknown item codes (promo_adjust_v2, promo_adjust_local). Error: NS_ERR_INVALID_ITEM_CODE for those 12. See /var/logs/netsync/20240315-48-backfill-1.err. Tagging @maya_finance for mapping decisions.

maya_finance: I'll add mapping entries for promo_adjust_v2 and promo_adjust_local in NetSuite mapping table and confirm with accounting. Once that's in, can we re-run the 12 failed ones?

sam_engineering: yes, re-run queued. Also adding an alert: if >5% of adjustments skip due to mapping errors send immediate page to billing.

maya_finance: great — thanks everyone. I'll update leadership and start the invoice correction approval workflow. :thumbsup:
